definitions.explanation: Any of various tiny flies that gather around kitchen scraps, fruit and drains, such as fruit flies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧コバエ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Small flies have appeared in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生|なま}ゴミ→生ゴミ：08044_namagomi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧コバエ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たかって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Little flies are swarming over the kitchen scraps.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧コバエ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧しやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧っぱなしにしないようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Small flies breed easily in summer, so I try not to leave fruit out.

notes:
Not one species: ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + {蝿|はえ} (fly) covers fruit flies, drain flies and fungus gnats alike. An everyday household word, and common on pest-control products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コバエ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧ / コバエ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: small flies breed
- コバエ{取|と}り: a fruit-fly trap

RELATED WORDS:
- {蝿|はえ}: fly
- ⟦{蚊|か}→蚊：04294_ka⟧: mosquito
